memory.allowHint: The assistant remembers your preferences and facts about you across chats.
memory.disclosure: Memory is sent to our LLM provider with your requests so the assistant can answer in the best way possible. Turning it off stops saving and using memory.
memory.offNote: Memory is off: saved notes are kept but not used. You can still delete them.
memory.addPlaceholder: Something the assistant should remember, e.g. I prefer evening games
memory.removeAllMessage: The assistant forgets everything it remembers about you. This cannot be undone.

context.hintWarn: This chat is getting long. Start a new chat for faster, more accurate answers.
context.hintCritical: This chat is almost full. Start a new chat — older messages are already being forgotten.
context.title: Context
context.explainOk: Each message sends the conversation so far to the assistant. Shorter chats are faster and more accurate.
context.explainLong: This chat is long: every message resends it, which costs more of your daily limit and makes answers less precise. Start a new chat — saved memory carries over.
context.dailyExplain: Shared across all your AI chats. When it runs out, the assistant pauses until the reset.
